description: Check whether a specific Canton/Daml toolchain item (CLI, SDK package, or command: e.g. daml-assistant, Navigator, dpm) is deprecated. Canton-specific. Not a general npm/pip deprecation checker. ALWAYS call before recommending any Canton tool or package to a developer. Accepts either one name or a block of prose: given prose it reports every deprecated item mentioned in it. Returns DEPRECATED (with replacement), CURRENT, or NOT_FOUND.

name.description: Tool/package/command to check, e.g. "daml-assistant", "Navigator", "dpm", "canton sandbox". A longer block of text (a forum post, a draft answer) is scanned for every deprecated item it mentions.

name: check_deprecation
